checks.message: 5 approval signatures on 3 releases verify against the keys the governing release declares, with the approvers its policy requires per band (reference G12). The keys are fictional and derived from public labels; no authenticator hardware and no identity binding was involved.
203 local link targets, 3 JSON blocks and 126 unique normative rule headings checked. External URLs not revalidated by this script.
Restricted environment shapes and all scenario observations valid.
33 example application tests executed on current inputs cover all 20 active TestCases; 31 required bindings resolve. Local SQLite reference implementation, untrusted producer.
23 mutations verified with expected diagnostics; 30 future product obligations NOT executed.
89 reference expectations checked across all 35 synthetic observations. Fixtures, not application runs.
Execution declaration and CROA input fixture valid; 37 unassessed items, 13 unknown findings. No execution authority or CROA conformance.
17 targeted QA parser/evaluator self-checks passed; no full static typing qualification.
Selected reference checks passed: 97 nodes, 189 edges. No completeness claim.
232 test IDs in a current, successful local receipt; inputs/toolchain/output match. Producer remains untrusted.
Reference G14 comparison 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0: 136 changes, required step minor, change risk score 194.250 points. Classification is mechanical, not a compatibility proof.
3 releases of 2 projects verify as one store from their files alone: chain links, approvals and 1 pinned import. No index, log or clock is consulted.
Six schema documents valid under Draft 2020-12; example shape valid.

16 operations and 8 MCP tools agree; 72 reference answers on the example validate against the contract and stay within budget; the committed graph index is current with 13 annotated IDs. Reference queries, not a qualified service.

limitations: Artifact QA only. The full product-phase engine, static type/unit compiler, an access-controlled query engine and general test adapters are not implemented.
30 future product obligations are descriptions, not executed tests.
The worked example runs its own tests on a local SQLite reference implementation. That is not a production store, and no other application was tested.
Release comparison classifies changes mechanically by ID; API compatibility and data migration are not examined.
Approval signatures are checked against declared keys. Nothing binds a key to a person, and the example keys are fictional.
Local untrusted runner; no runtime isolation or production approval.
Reference evaluation is not proof of business completeness, formal equivalence or all executions.
